name: phase_01_invitation_acceptance
lock_risk: Adds nullable binding and replay columns, replaces closed check constraints, and validates existing Identity rows without rewriting token, session, membership, or invitation data.
representative_data: Runs against empty, previous-version, current, and deterministic Phase 01 identity lanes; live tests exercise new-principal and existing-principal invitation acceptance through the atlas_api role.
query_plan_review: Invitation authentication and acceptance use the invitation primary key under row lock; external-subject uniqueness and membership tenant-principal uniqueness serialize callback and acceptance races without a new broad index.
space_risk: Adds nullable SHA-256 digests and accepted-state identifiers only; raw invitation tokens, full email addresses, and upstream OIDC tokens remain non-recoverable.
forward_fix: Disable invitation authentication and acceptance routes, preserve accepted membership and Audit facts, and add a new ordered migration for any constraint, replay, or session-binding correction.
rollback: Disable the two invitation-acceptance routes before a forward fix; never revert an accepted invitation, delete its membership or Audit fact, restore a revoked bootstrap session, or recover secret material.
